notes: The diagnostics now survive the extension going to sleep. Chrome stops an extension's background worker after about 30 seconds idle, and everything it remembered goes with it - which is why the last report came back with the new section missing entirely, two minutes after a run.

It also reports how old that background worker is. If the worker is younger than the run it is describing, Chrome restarted it in the middle - and that is the leading explanation for reports landing loose in Downloads while no other extension has touched them.
